summary: Random forest (sklearn defaults) achieves higher stratified 5-fold CV ROC-AUC than logistic regression (sklearn defaults) on the Adult Income dataset, though the margin is modest (~1-1.5 AUC points) and RF wins consistently across repeated CV and a fresh held-out split.
primary_metric_name: ROC-AUC difference (RF - LogReg), 5-fold stratified CV mean
methodological_choices: Missing values in workclass/occupation/native-country (categorical only) filled with an explicit 'Missing' category rather than dropped or mode-imputed. Categorical features one-hot encoded (handle_unknown='ignore'); numeric features standardized (StandardScaler) in the same shared ColumnTransformer pipeline for both models, so both models see identical preprocessed input for fairness (scaling does not affect RF but is applied for consistency). Target encoded as 1 for '>50K', 0 for '<=50K'. Both estimators used scikit-learn default hyperparameters except LogisticRegression max_iter raised from 100 to 1000 solely to reach solver convergence on the one-hot-encoded design matrix (lbfgs default solver otherwise throws a ConvergenceWarning); random_state=42 fixed on both estimators and the CV splitter for reproducibility (RandomForestClassifier's default random_state is None, so pinning it does not change any hyperparameter, just removes run-to-run seed variance). Evaluation metric: ROC-AUC via StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True). No explicit class-imbalance handling (class_weight left at default 'None' for both) since ~24% positive rate is not severe and ROC-AUC is relatively insensitive to moderate imbalance.
verification_method: (1) Repeated stratified 5-fold CV with 5 different random seeds (1-5; 25 folds total per model) to check the primary result isn't an artifact of one particular fold split. (2) A fresh 80/20 stratified held-out split (random_state=999, never used in the CV above) with both models refit on the 80% training portion and evaluated once on the untouched 20% test portion.
verification_result: Held: RF outperformed LR in all 0/25 folds across 5 seeds of repeated 5-fold CV (paired t-test t=-9.69, p=9.15e-10). Overall repeated-CV mean AUC: RF=0.90266 (sd=0.00271), LR=0.90668 (sd=0.00252), mean diff=-0.00402, consistent with the primary single-run estimate of -0.00434. On the independent fresh 80/20 held-out split, RF AUC=0.90134 vs LR AUC=0.90577 (diff=-0.00443), also confirming RF > LR.
